description: Activate when: user asks 'does this business have a moat', 'what stops competitors from copying us', 'how defensible is this company', 'is this advantage durable', evaluating a company for investment or acquisition, designing startup strategy for long-term defensibility, reviewing an investor pitch's competitive-advantage claims. Do NOT activate when: time horizon is under 1 year (moat is multi-year); question is about immediate execution tactics or a single-quarter decision. More: deciqai.com/c/economic-moat
